description: Onboarding state is a fact about the ACCOUNT but is read only from localStorage, in a file that already knows whether the user is signed in. The server can answer it; the browser cannot. This is the shape of the real bug it was written for. Named WelcomePanel rather than Onboarding on purpose: runCustomRules skips any path matching /onboarding/i, so a fixture with the obvious name is silently never scanned.
